profile.headline: Data Infrastructure at Attentive Mobile
profile.summary: Graduated with a Bachelor's of Science degree in Computer Science at the University of San Francisco. Currently employed as an SDE2 at AWS working on Aurora Storage. Main focus points are availability, security, and scalability of the metadata gateway for the dataplane supporting Postgres, MySQL, DocDB, and GraphDB. Previously employed as an engineer at Target on the Cloud and Compute team focusing on edge deployment utilizing Kubernetes.

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer 2
positions.description:
As a Software Development Engineer II, played a key role in developing and maintaining the control plane for Amazon Aurora’s storage system. Some responsibilities included designing and implementing services that manage the lifecycle, scalability, and orchestration of Aurora’s distributed storage infrastructure.

With expertise in core AWS services like EC2, S3, and DynamoDB, focused on enhancing automation for resource provisioning, optimizing data replication across multiple Availability Zones, and ensuring seamless integration with Aurora’s compute layer. Collaboration with cross-functional teams is essential to improving data durability, performance, and recovery capabilities, allowing Aurora Storage to meet the needs of enterprises with demanding data infrastructure requirements.

Through these efforts, was able to support the ongoing innovation of AWS’s data services, helping customers handle large-scale workloads efficiently and reliably.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a Platform Engineer, with a strong focus on building and maintaining application deployment platforms and data pipelines. This role involved managing deployments across a Kubernetes-based infrastructure that spans over 1,000 3-node Kubernetes clusters, with a particular emphasis on IoT edge based solutions.

With expertise in optimizing and automating deployment processes, ensuring scalability, reliability, and efficiency for hundreds of applications. With a commitment to leveraging cutting-edge technologies, they drive continuous improvement in platform capabilities, enabling development teams to deliver high-quality applications with speed and security.

positions.title: Application Development Intern
positions.description: Worked on writing Unit Tests for numerous applications. In doing so, created a how-to presentation with the standards of writing tests in order to move towards a test-driven development style. Created a job application page for one of the new showrooms being opened. All work was related to Spring and Spring Boot, with the use of Thymeleaf template engine and Java Server Pages. Created and modified RESTful APIs.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description: Worked as a Computer Science department general tutor. Hold office hours every day to assist students in understanding computer science.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Aided in the teaching of four different Computer Science classes. Classes were Introduction to Systems and C, Computer Networks, Programming Language Paradigms, and Performance Engineering.

positions.title: Community Assistant
positions.description: Worked the Front Desk in a student residence hall on the USF campus, acting as a first line of security and customer service.

positions.title: Physical Merchandiser
positions.description: Worked in a warehouse at a furniture store. Experienced working in teams to complete daily tasks. Provided customer service to all people encountered in day to day operations.

volunteerExperiences.description: Conducted weekly trips to a KIPP Bayview Middle School. Presented different Computer Science projects. Collaborated with a team of 3 to promote the education and interest of Computer Science as a field.
